newsitem.title: USA: Wayne County may sell $100 mln bonds for airport.
newsitem.headline: Wayne County may sell $100 mln bonds for airport.

text.p: Wayne County may issue approximately $100 million of bonds for interim building projects at Detroit's Metro Airport in late summer or early fall, the county's deputy chief financial officer said Monday.
The issuance would finance smaller improvements to existing facilities, Deputy Chief Financial Officer Susan Kopinski said.
Government Finance Associates Inc has been chosen as financial adviser for the deal and Miller Canfield, Paddock and Stone will serve as bond counsel, Kopinski said.
Kopinski said county officials hope to issue requests for proposals for underwriters for the deal in early July if possible.

Wayne County is in the process of preparing for a new $1 billion expansion at Metro Airport. Kopinski said Wayne County does not expect to issue the bulk of the bonds for the expansion until late 1998 or early 1999.
